item.title: Greenlight Concept - Article - Horror/History -Related to Sarkicism & CotBG
item.description: Seeking review of concept for an SCP article. Tried this out about nine years ago, did bad, and want to give it another go having read a lot more of the material and matured as a writer/person.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlight: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Horror & History

Page Layout (Optional): Standard in-depth containment procedure, followed by a retrieval log and accompanied by a brief test log with two or three addenda related to the nature of the SCP. I don't want to perform anything out of the ordinary format-wise with it being my first entry, but a timeline of the SCP's apprehension by groups of interest may be relevant.

Elevator Pitch:

A forest-spirit/lesser goddess of creation and fertility that asexually births creatures based
upon what she consumes is captured by the Church of the Broken God, and turned into a weapon to convert organic material into inorganic material. They lose her, and she exchanges hands between organizations for hundreds of years before ending up in foundation custody totally unrecognizable to what she once was, with a sinister corruption of her godly ability.

Central Narrative:

Following the first war of the Flesh, Cyrus the Great founded a covenant to search the world for a new means to defeat the Sarkic threat. This group set out, with generations passing before eventually finding a minor fertility goddess unique in her ability to produce life asexually and rapidly by consuming organic matter. They captured her, but became indoctrinated by the Church of the Broken God over time, and augmented her heavily. She would eventually escape with the aid of a man enamored with her, and sire a child with him, the location of which is unknown but she is believed to be endowed with the same ability. Over time different organizations got ahold of the spirit and altered her repeatedly to suit their needs or designs with her now bordering on unrecognizable as herself.

Her modern iteration is a mess of added mechanical and organic apertures both internal and external that have removed her god-like beauty to some extent. Her mistreatment by mankind has jaded her to the point of being predatory, and resulted in her fractured psyche turning to exploitation and predation of mankind through producing her unique offspring. Organic material she consumed is now converted into mechanically augmented horrors when she births them, and vice versa.

Hook/Attention-Grabber:

The concept of the perversion of sexuality, creation, and birth for the purpose of furthering an agenda is enticing and provocative. Taking an earthly minor-goddess of creation and weaponizing her between the Sarkites and Mekhanites and turning her into a cog in the war machine between them serves as a potent analogy for the corruption of life and nature to fit the destruction of it, while sympathizing the reader to a malignant goddess that was once benign and pure.

Additional Notes: I believe I've thought this through reasonably well, but am making space to afford the word count. Some gaps in reasoning are apparent here that I don't have space to explain.

item.title: SCP idea (draft available)
item.description: Seeking greenlight status in order to then (as a draft has already been written) seek review and such for a new SCP idea
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Drama/Emotional

Page Layout (Optional): Procedures, Description, and an Interview. Open to adding more, such as testing logs, or diary entries.

Elevator Pitch: A child discovers he can make living shadow puppets on walls with a light source and his hands. Unfortunately, he doesn't know how to completely control them. Ends with implications that the Foundation may use him as a weapon.

Central Narrative: A child is playing under a blanket fort with his parents. After his father shows him how to make shadow puppets with a flashlight and his hands, the child follows suit. The shadows he makes are living, and proceed to "devour" his parents. After not seeing the family leave their house for a while, police are called to the scene. After they enter, gunshots are heard, and then shadows dart around the house. A junior researcher who lives nearby calls in the situation and Foundation agents contain the child. The junior researcher is assigned to the SCP and tries to calm him down, though he knows what the Foundation might do to the child.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The story of an innocent child doing normal things that becomes under the control of the cold and calculating Foundation.

Additional Notes: As mentioned, I already have a sandbox page with the first draft written. I had written the majority of this idea in a notebook, and then transferred the idea to my sandbox before I had found out about greenlighting. I apologize for going out of order.

item.title: (Seeking Greenlight) Class-D claims to be an 05
item.description: Class-D claims to be 05-14, yet there are no records of him every being on the 05 council or there ever being a 14th member of the 05
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): mainly mystery, slight comedy,

Page Layout (Optional): Aiming to make it as short and simple as I can

Elevator Pitch: A Class-D claims to be an 05-14, no proof of him being an 05, but there is mystery as how he got this way.

Central Narrative: There is a Class-D who claims to be an 05 council member. Due to little evidence supporting him, and a history supporting him being a Class-D, they do not make him an 05. However, they do not terminate him at the end of the month and make him a SCP because he knows stuff only an 05 knows.
Hook/Attention-Grabber: At the end of the SCP in an addendum, the site director says something like, "We do not know for certain that he is an 05 despite him having classified information. He could be an attempt at infiltration by a GoI, a Class-D who anomalously got his hands on classified information and is attempting to avoid end-of-the-month termination. Maybe he actually is 05-14 and was placed as a Class-D. We really do not know anything about him, and it is much safer to simply contain him than to blindly trust any assumptions. Rest assured, we are investigating this."

Additional Notes: If I manage to fit it in somehow, I can imply that some sort of group inside the Foundation intend to put him back up into the 05 council. As in, maybe some guard slips him a note saying that he believes him, and intends to break him out/investigate it himself. Also, apologies for any mistakes I make, this is my first post ever on the site and I really want to start writing an article after lurking for a couple of years.

item.title: A multidimensional book about records
item.description: A book containing all the records
item.content:encoded:
A book containing all the records set by any entity in any dimension in all of existence. (SCP version of Guinness world records but a multiversal edition)

Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: Tale

Genre: Drama/Emotional, Comedy,

Page Layout: Standard

Elevator Pitch: The vehement struggle of a researcher coming to terms with the "record" his father holds.

Central Narrative: A researcher is tasked to read through the book containing countless records. Through fan post/mails send from all over the universes, he comes to learn that his idol, his father, is not the man he had imagined him to be. The book itself has no other anomalous qualities then depicting the records.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: I think that the premise, of a record book in a world full of extremes, is an interesting idea and something which would draw a lot of attention, provided it is done in a sufficient manner. Many parallels to existing SCPs could be drawn as well. The conflict with the unspeakable atrocity the father might have committed should serve as the main point of interest.

-Whatever crime the father has committed will not be mentioned-

After a lengthy discussion on the critters forum, I came to the conclusion, that this idea is better suited for a tale. It is just a revisited idea of an older idea of mine here is a link to it http://www.scpwiki.com/forum/t-13137282/scp-idea-a-multidimensional-book-about-records

And this is a modernized version of the first thread I had written about the tale idea. Back then, the idea was not fleshed out enough. link http://www.scpwiki.com/forum/t-13675691/a-multidimensional-book-about-records#post-4759034

I do hope that it now is better suited for the said endeavour.

item.title: Seeking Greenlight
item.description: Tale about SCP-745 ("Headlights") from the point of view of an MTF operative
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: Tale

Page Layout: Short story, simple page

Elevator Pitch: An MTF operative recounts his last night on assignment with SCP-745

Central Narrative: SCP-745 has long been contained, so years of uneventful shifts have resulted in a culture of complacency within the group tasked with maintaining security. One night that boredom is broken by strange occurrences among the specimens, and the team tries make sense of the situation while responding with limited resources and little support.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: Wanting to express a sense of realism through a down-to-earth look at the MTF team- a lackluster assignment, and one member's first-person recollections of the events. Also, those events are never really explained, and much is left to be implied, sparking the reader's imagination.

Additional Notes: I've always thought the 745 story has lots of potential for lore-building.

item.title: Greenlight time?
item.description: The indigenous American Coyote character escapes to his own metanarrative properties, and the Foundation seeks to stop him from spreading to other folklore.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre: Mostly an exploration of a cool idea

Page Layout: Bog-standard SCP format

Elevator Pitch: The set of Indigenous American stories about Coyote are an anomalous set of living narrative and metanarrative characteristics, which the Foundation worries might "jump" into other contemporary narratives. "Coyote" fools the Foundation and involves the Chaos Insurgency

Central Narrative: There is definitely a plot to this, but I hope you'll find it interesting enough to warrant such a big explanation:

+ show block
– hide block

A culture's practices and beliefs determine its stories, right? But what if the stories start to have a mind (or agenda) of their own? A Foundation anthropologist reports that the set of stories about Coyote acts differently from any other set of stories about a character (indigenous or otherwise); specifically, the stories and the overall set itself shares Coyote's characteristics, as well as some instinct for self preservation and an unknown degree of sapience. This worries the Foundation, who are concerned about what would happen if Coyote discovers how to (or maybe just decides to) jump into other contemporary narrative-sets. They have no idea what will happen in that scenario.

A year later, Foundation web-sweeper bots detect a set of movie concepts, novel plots, and fanfiction arcs, many involving birds of some kind, which overall "behaved like a narrative animal, but with more personality", similarly to the Coyote set. The foundation at first classifies this as a new, similar SCP, but the anthropologist later realizes that it is in fact a containment breach, where "Coyote took the form of a bird". The site is taken down, and it is discovered that many of the original posts were made by the teenage daughter of a former member of the Chaos Insurgency of Kootenai descent.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The Foundation deals with a metanarrative SCP and gets hoodwinked. The Chaos Insurgency gets involved.

Additional Notes: The most important thing I want to watch out for is that I don't mis-portray parts of any Native American culture(s). That being said, this very much isn't the mythical figure of Coyote as an SCP (that'd be both stupid and impossible to write), but is a conscious set of stories which act similar to the character they portray. The point is to look at how the foundation will handle an SCP like this, and vice versa…

Upon the discovery of SCP, mobile Task Force Omega-22 “copycat catchers” was created to stop the anti foundation from gaining power.

item.title: Hikikomori
item.description: Seeking greenlight for an already written draft about a hikikomori that becomes a SCP object.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Horror, Drama/Emotional

Page Layout (Optional): Tabs for different security levels, each with different Special Containment Procedures. Clickable subsections within.

Elevator Pitch: A hikikomori ends up as a SCP entity by means of apparent suicide, becoming capable of entering reality from other people's dreams. Except that by doing so, he just discovered something very wrong about our reality.

Central Narrative: The ability to enter reality turns out to not be just a gimmick. Like the plot twist in the film "The Others", the roles are flipped: the SCP entity is more real that our waking life. Turns out that the SCP Foundation is protecting the waking reality itself by keeping that very secret. One of the things to do is to prevent real human contact with the hikikomori.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The story uses a similar layered security format as SCP-2718. Accurate information about the SCP and the very existence of that information turns out to be what is being contained, besides the entity itself.

Additional Notes: I already have a complete draft ready. The article links to SCP-2718 and SCP-2000, which are significant inspirations. However, this is a more traditional SCP article that doesn't in any way attempt to copy those two, and lacks the sort of semirealistic narrative as used in SCP-2817. I did not want to link this to the Oneiroi lore, and generally there are very few links to other SCPs.

item.title: Suicide Spore
item.description: Friendly SCP with a deadly disease.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes.
Page type: SCP Article.
Elevator Pitch: An SCP that is friendly and compliant with containment, and will change its looks and actions to suit the observer best (it is an empathetic metamorph). There is a catch, though - any creature that has been in contact with it for an extended period of time will develop worrying symptoms that inclde an evental suicide, and these subjects are capable of indirectly spreading this "disease" (SCP-XXXX-2).
Central Narrative: SCP-XXXX is a friendly anomaly, found by the foundation after recieving reports of unnatural high suicide rates in North-West London. It was compliant with containment and is happy to stay isolated to guarantee the safety of others, thogh it is often reported to seem lonely and openly express this. However, it willingly stays in containment as to not endanger any more lives. It has often stated that it thinks SCP-XXXX-2 is the problem, and that it is simply infected with it, but research cannot be made of the matter.
Hook/Attention-Grabber: This is something I would need help with. Personally I think that the SCP willingly being contained without any special requests is interesting enough - I haven't seen any sentient SCPs that are willingly contained to save human lives. If you can find one please tell me, I'd love to read one.
Additional Notes: I do have a sandbox with a basic draft for this, but I'm afraid it's pretty poorly-written in my opinion.

Please tell me if I have missed any rules or anything, or if I have done this completely wrong.

item.title: SCP-XXXX
item.description: What do you think of that idea ?
item.content:encoded:
Hello there. So I had this idea of a bedroom. It doesn't look abnormal at first glance. However, when one walk inside, they will enter a state of euphoria, giggling for no apparent reasons. When they do this, they are designated as SCP-XXX-A. Once in that euphoric state, they will grab as many pillows as they can find in the room, and exit it. They will then run around, looking for a human being. Then, once they found one, they will throw a pillow at the person and start a pillow fight with them. The "target" will be designated as SCP-XXX-B. If SCP-XXX-B catches the pillow, they will enter the same state of euphoria and fight back with the pillow. Once the fight is done, SCP-XXX-A will go back to looking for another human being to "contaminate", and SCP-XXX-B will do the same.

However, if the target doesn't catch the pillow, they will not enter the euphoric state, and SCP-XXX-A will be discontent, trying to throw it back at SCP-XXX-B until they catch it. If someone stays with SCP-XXX-A in the same room for around 10 minutes, they will enter the state of euphoria, even if they didn't catch the pillow, and the room they were in takes the same abnormal properties as the original SCP-XXXX.

Once contaminated, SCP-XXX-A will never leave that euphoric state and must be terminated.

Keter or Euclide class. I was thinking of calling it "The Best Slumber Party Ever".

What do you think ? Has something similar already been done ?

The overall narrative is that the 05 are in a position of power and could abuse their power whenever and however they want. I'm hoping to make this multiple connections between SCP's.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The hook is more about how "unstable" the SCP is. Most foundation members (are assumed) to have a high IQ. This SCP doesn't allow high IQ's around it. The SCP is somewhat of a threat to the 05 command and is neutralized for that reason.

item.title: Dr Cheese SCP idea.
item.description: My new Proposal for an SCP. Might be really bad (again) but I enjoyed it :)
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes.

Page Type: SCP Article.

Genre: My design is meant to be spooky, but I may not achieve this factor.

Page Layout: The usual SCP statements, Item Name, Item Class but no picture. Information is going to be structured in the following layout; Appearance description (Height, weight, colour and shape), Discovery (How the anomaly was contained), Abilities (What the anomaly can do, how it does it etc) and the Addendums (Stories about previously explained things).

Elevator Pitch: The basic premise is a tall, slender, arctic hunter with elongated shoulder growths and large elbows, glowing crimson eyes, capable of seeing infrared radiation and heat signatures. This is used as a hunting technique in the arctic weather. The anomaly has thousands of tiny muscles on its skin capable of moving guanine crystals to adjust the wavelength of light being reflected off the skin of the anomaly. This is commonly known as camouflage, and is the same method that the Chamaeleonidae (Common Chameleon) uses. Bone marrow scans and nervous axon scans have suggested that overgrowths on the anomaly's shoulder blades and elbows contain many nerve endings, which transfer electrical signals in large amounts to a particular area which creates an electromagnetic field. These electromagnetic pulses disrupt nearby local electric signals. It may use this to alter the function of electrical signals in the brain, or to inhibit power of technology.

Central Narrative: The narrative for initial containment is the following: It was a normal day in the UK Arctic Research Facility. Cold, as usual, but the sacred electric heaters were keeping staff alive. It was collection day, where the scientific staff would take a collection of snow for carbon-testing, a process where the amount of carbon that is in a snowflake is collected to see the effects of the greenhouse effect. As the staff left the facility, the power went out. As the staff stumbled over to the generator, senior researcher Noel Leon noticed a small red glow. Must have been nothing. H got back to fixing the generator. The fuses had been replaced. They become brittle and break in the cold weather. But as soon as the generator start-up was initiated, the generator failed. What was going on? Suddenly, pat… pat… pat…. Something was behind him, but when he turned around, there was nothing but footprints. SNAP. The crunch of his bones in SCP-XXXX's mouth was horrifying, but unheard to remaining staff. As it entered the facility, seven of it's prey had already been frozen. An easy meal. Junior researcher Doctor Edward turned a corner, but the anomaly was gone, just a frozen, half-eaten corpse. The rest of the facility was wiped out, with the exception of Doctor Bradly was obliterated by SCP-XXXX. Doctor Bradly called local authorities and the foundation was alerted. MTF unit Delta-92 Snow-and-Tell was sent to the situation and captured the anomaly.

item.title: SCP Idea: Home is where the mind is.
item.description: A house that changes it’s inside, depending on the mentality of whoever’s living within it. (Need criticism and help for Greenlight!)
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre: Psychological Horror, Weird, Mixed Genres

Elevator Pitch: The basic concept is a singular home that changes the inside of itself physically to reflect the current mental state of whoever is living inside it. When first entering the home, it’s exactly the same for every person (Just a normal middle-class home with nothing strange.) Once the person becomes accommodated to the house (feels comfortable calling it their own home), that’s when the house begins to slowly change over time. (I’ll go through some small examples later on) The house mainly focuses on the subconscious/repressed thoughts and current temperament. The house itself isn’t inherently malicious, or has any goal. It simply just does what it does.

Central Narrative: The plan is to have the foundation do research on the house using a number of different D-class personnel with varying different backgrounds and personalities. My main vision for this SCP is having about 5-7 different experiment logs, each with a different outcome of what happens. It’ll begin with a brief description and background of the house’s current subject, before logging and explaining all the changes caught on camera/ told by the subject. A sort of list that I came up with lists the general mood I want from each section
1. normal interaction (Not too boring as to bore the reader, but some strange stuff happens)
2. cute interaction (A test on an animal, such as a dog. This is to lul the reader into a false sense of security)
3. weird interaction (More abstract things happen around the house.)
4. emotional interaction (This one I’m not so sure on, but it could be about a dead relative, or something similar)
5. really weird interaction (Things get far more intense and abstract, and may see how people start disappearing within the home.)
6. scary interaction (Straight up physical horror)
7. [REDACTED] (straight up unexplainable/eldritch horror type stuff.
Hook/Attention-Grabber: I hope the main hook of this SCP to audiences is having them wonder “What would the house do for me?” due to the house having a completely different experience to whomever enters it.

Additional Notes:
Examples:
A woman with claustrophobia slowly gets trapped inside the house.

An optimistic/life loving man becomes obsessed with the house and refuses to leave.

I'd love to know what everyone thinks/what I can do to improve this SCP! :)

item.title: The M&M Gang

Additional Notes: I would like to thank,forgot their name, for suggesting this idea.
